newsitem.title: CHINA: First Tibet industrial company to list A shares.
newsitem.headline: First Tibet industrial company to list A shares.

text.p: A Tibetan industrial company will shortly issue 15 million A shares at four yuan per share and list them on the Shanghai stock exchange, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.
The issue includes 1.5 million employee shares, which will be listed six months after the main listing, it said.
Tibet Shengdi (Holy Land) Company Ltd is the first industrial company from Tibet to issue shares and its main product is a brand of mineral water, it said but gave no more details.
Tibet Pearl Star Co, a hotel group, listed A shares in Shanghai in February 1995 but most of its assets are in the southwest province of Sichuan and not in Tibet.
